value.rationale: The object (random shadow area) and normalized variance are intrinsic scale-free geometric anisotropy measurements. The result classifies the optimal height for every compact planar convex base and provides a sharp universal comparison over infinitely many shapes with exact equality iff constant width. The dependence only on the squared planar width coefficient and its strictly monotone optimized law exposes a structural invariant; the equilateral example proves average and worst-view uniformity are distinct goals. Unlike a moment table, the complete shape/equality classification is a motivated structural theorem.
